requirement: POST /v1/demos: an account token asks for a demo; idempotent, capped at live demos per account, model budget, guarded photo fetch, nothing written on refusal

oracle.invariant: S1: same key + body → same demo, other body → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; concurrent and after-crash retries make one demo. S1: the 21st live demo → 409 DEMO_LIMIT_REACHED {live:20, limit:20}; deleting one makes room; at the cap only one of concurrent requests wins. S1: over the model budget → 503 SPONSOR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED before accepting; an own AI account reserves 0 cents. S1: bad schema / oversize / private or redirected-private photo URL → 4xx with no row and no stored object; a seat key → 403; accountId/siteKey/ownSite in the body refused by field. S1: cancel before the build frees the slot, after keeps it; ready only with QA passed; polling never moves the retention dates. S2: unknown fields (verified, provenance, objectKey, accountId) are refused by path.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
